sloka: न ते अम्बा मध्यमा तात गर्हितव्या कथंचन ।ताम् एव इक्ष्वाकु नाथस्य भरतस्य कथाम् कुरु ॥३-१६-३७॥
transliteration: na te ambā madhyamā tāta garhitavyā kathaṁcana ।tām eva ikṣvāku nāthasya bharatasya kathām kuru ॥3-16-37॥

translations.english: O dear, Kaikeyi, our second mother, is never to be criticised like that. You may, however, speak more of Bharata, the lord of the Iksvakus.
